==Description==
'''Musaceae Kingdom''' is a private server-exclusive [[Maps|map]] that takes place on a tropical island.

'''Musaceae Kingdom''' has the [[All Paths]] modifier, which duplicates all enemies for each path with the exception of bosses. It also increases {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} rewards by 10%.

==Design & Path==
'''Musaceae Kingdom''' takes place on tropical isles with several cliffs on top with a castle and multiple other smaller buildings. The buildings are made out of grey bricks with red or blue roofs. There are also multiple other smaller islands and some floating rocks. A few airships can be seen around the main island. There are also small beaches with palm trees at the bottom of the cliffs. Two statues and a kraken can also be found in the water. There are multiple trees on the cliffs, some of them being palm trees with bananas growing on them. On the cliffs, you can also find a few rocks and bushes. Cliffs are connected by bridges. Most of them are basic wooden bridges, while the bridge to the castle is made out of stone. There are also multiple cannons placed around the map.

One of the paths starts at a cave, while the other starts at an airship. Both paths end at a castle. The paths are relatively long and wind around the island on the map. The paths conjoin in the middle of the map and then go toward the castle.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Insane|Modifiers = 1.1|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*All enemies, except the major boss spawn twice on this map due to the [[All Paths]] modifier.
**The increased amount of enemies allows you to gain more cash by damaging enemies.
***The [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] can also generate more cash because of this.
*It is recommended to place your towers where the paths intersect.
**Do note that ground space is a bit limited here, as is it generally only close to the path. This means you may not want to use the [[Turret]], as it has a bigger placement footprint.
***The [[Military Base]] and [[Farm]] should also be placed far away from the area where you place down your DPS towers, as they will take up important space.
*As both paths have a very similar length, once the paths intersect enemies from each path will be very close to each other, making area of effect towers like the [[Gladiator]], [[Mortar]] or [[Executioner]] very useful here, especially ones with large AOE damage.
**Area of effect towers should be placed near the intersection or at the island at the end.
**The [[Ace Pilot]] can also be used early on during the game because of its splash damage. It should be placed at the last island with the tower, because of its path.
**As most ground spots near the combined paths are very close to the path, the [[Rocketeer]] may not be that useful here because of its deadzone range.
*While this map has quite a lot of cliff spots, they are far apart from each other, making cliff towers a bit less useful here.
**Cliff towers should be placed on the cliff near the intersection.

==Trivia==
*The map is named after the biological family [[wp:Musaceae|Musaceae]], which includes bananas and plantains.
